results.label: Elder intro card: Elder Oni
results.brief: Write the one-line intro card shown on the map node of the Elder Oni, before the duel starts.

draft.text: The Elder Oni holds his snowy shrine gate, and once his iron club swings, no flurry of jabs will turn it aside.

sources.line: | Elder Oni | 5 or 8 | Armour on every special |
| Habit the twist breaks | Mashing jabs to interrupt it stops working |
Proud and blunt, it dashes in and swings an iron club.

critic_issues.quote: once his iron club swings, no flurry of jabs will turn it aside
critic_issues.problem: The draft ties the armour to the club swing, which misstates the twist: the armour is on every special, the club is also swung in ordinary attacks, and Oni Quake (a ground pound) gets no mention, so the player cannot work out the real twist.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Yokai.md#Oni: Elder twist | Armour on every special
critic_issues.fix: Name the trigger as every one of his signature or big committed blows, not his club swing, so the reader learns that each special shrugs off jabs.

critic_issues.problem: The ordinary Oni's Iron-Club Charge already has 1-hit armour, so armour on the club charge does not tell the player what the elder adds.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Abilities.md#Specials: Iron-Club Charge | Oni, common | 16 / 6 / 24 | 110 | Forward charge with 1-hit armour
critic_issues.fix: Make the line cover all of his special blows rather than the charge the regular Oni already armours.

critic_issues.quote: holds his snowy shrine gate, and once his iron club swings
critic_issues.problem: The card carries two concrete images, the snowy shrine gate and the iron club, where the card form allows one.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#Card form: Present tense, plain words, one concrete image per card
critic_issues.fix: Keep a single image, for example drop the gate and build the line around his blows shrugging off jabs.

critic_issues.quote: no flurry of jabs will turn it aside
critic_issues.problem: The clause uses the future tense where cards are written in the present tense.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#Card form: Present tense, plain words, one concrete image per card
critic_issues.fix: Recast in present tense, for example "no flurry of jabs turns it aside".

draft.text: Every special the Elder Oni throws shrugs off a flurry of jabs, the way rain runs off a roof tile.

sources.line: | Elder Oni | 5 or 8 | Armour on every special |
| Habit the twist breaks | Mashing jabs to interrupt it stops working |

critic_issues.quote: Every special the Elder Oni throws
critic_issues.problem: The draft says the Oni 'throws' its specials, but they are a charge and a ground pound, and 'throws' is the word for the Elder Kappa's twist, so a player could misread which twist this card teaches.
critic_issues.evidence: 02-mechanics/Abilities.md#Specials: Iron-Club Charge | Oni, common | ... | Forward charge with 1-hit armour; Oni Quake ◆ | Oni, rare | ... | Ground pound; hits low (and 01-vibe/Story.md#Elder intro cards: Elder Kappa | Its throws can't be broken)
critic_issues.fix: Swap 'throws' for a verb the Oni's moves support, such as 'Every charge the Elder Oni makes shrugs off a flurry of jabs, the way rain runs off a roof tile.'

draft.text: Every special the Elder Oni uses shrugs off a flurry of jabs, the way rain runs off a roof tile.

critic_issues.quote: Every special the Elder Oni uses shrugs off a flurry of jabs, the way rain runs off a roof tile.
critic_issues.problem: The line teaches the armour twist clearly, but it fails two of the three tone checks: nobody teases, bargains or gets away with something, and nothing is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#The tone line: Three checks for any line of text: Mischief: someone in the line is teasing, bargaining or getting away with something. Melancholy: something is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind.
critic_issues.fix: Add a small melancholy touch from the Oni's own lore, e.g. "Still keeping a gate no one may pass, the Elder Oni lets every special shrug off jabs like rain off a roof tile."

results.label: Elder intro card: Elder Kappa
results.brief: Write the one-line intro card shown on the map node of the Elder Kappa, before the duel starts.

draft.text: The Elder Kappa walks politely into throw range on the lantern riverbank, and no one slips free once it takes hold.

sources.line: | Elder Kappa | 5 or 8 | Its throws can't be broken |
Formal, stubborn and polite, it walks straight into throw range.
The grappler of the lantern riverbank.

critic_issues.quote: and no one slips free once it takes hold
critic_issues.problem: The line has no melancholy: nothing in it is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind. The Kappa's inescapable grip is its only beat, so the card fails one of the three checks the tone line applies to every line of text.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#The tone line: "Three checks for any line of text: ... Melancholy: something is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind."
critic_issues.fix: Keep the twist clause and add a small, specific melancholy touch within 140 characters, such as the elder bowing first as though it still owes a courtesy from some earlier autumn.

draft.text: Made to fight again each loop, the Elder Kappa walks politely into throw range, where its throws cannot be broken.

sources.line: | Elder Kappa | 5 or 8 | Its throws can't be broken |
Formal, stubborn and polite, it walks straight into throw range.
The yokai are real spirits trapped in the Tanuki's illusion and made to fight again each loop, which is why Ryo's apologies matter.

critic_issues.quote: Made to fight again each loop, the Elder Kappa walks politely into throw range, where its throws cannot be broken.
critic_issues.problem: The card has no concrete image from the game's world; it is all action and rule, with no lantern, riverbank, bow, water dish or similar.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#Card form: Present tense, plain words, one concrete image per card: a lantern, a paper screen, a tail, a teacup, an ink stroke.
critic_issues.fix: Anchor the line in one image from the Kappa's world, such as the lantern riverbank or the water dish on its head, while keeping it to one sentence under 140 characters.

critic_issues.quote: where its throws cannot be broken
critic_issues.problem: This states the elder's twist as a game rule in fighting-game terms instead of describing what a person standing there would see.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#Card form: A card does not explain a rule in system words. It does not say "health", "frames", "level" or "roguelite"; it says what a person standing there would see.
critic_issues.fix: Show the unbreakable grip as something seen, such as a hold that no one has ever slipped once the Kappa takes it, so the player can still work out that its throws can't be broken.

draft.text: On the lantern riverbank the Elder Kappa bows, steps politely into reach, and once it takes hold, no one slips free.

sources.line: | Elder Kappa | 5 or 8 | Its throws can't be broken |
The grappler of the lantern riverbank.
Formal, stubborn and polite, it walks straight into throw range.

critic_issues.quote: On the lantern riverbank the Elder Kappa bows, steps politely into reach, and once it takes hold, no one slips free.
critic_issues.problem: The line has mischief and stays clear of horror, but it fails the melancholy check: nothing in it is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind.
critic_issues.evidence: 01-vibe/Tone.md#The tone line: Three checks for any line of text: ... Melancholy: something is owed, borrowed, waiting or left behind.
critic_issues.fix: Add a small specific cost or wait, such as the elder bowing as if keeping a match long owed, and keep the inescapable-hold clause so the line stays one sentence under 140 characters.
